top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes the most mature and unified achievement: incorporating firm heterogeneity and endogenous selection into trade analysis, connecting firm behavior, reallocation, and aggregate gains. Melitz is indispensable, while Helpman and Redding are defensible complementary recipients only under this tightly bounded programmatic citation.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile with respect to the proposed laureates.
